# Mishra Property Dealer

> Mishra Property Dealer is a local real estate agency serving Ramnagar and nearby parts of Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. The website publishes residential, plot, and commercial property listings and provides buying, renting, selling, valuation, site-visit, and documentation support.

## Verified site facts
- Business name: Mishra Property Dealer
- Primary service area: Ramnagar, Varanasi
- Additional service areas named on the site: Nadesar, Sigra, Lanka, Bhelupur and nearby Varanasi localities
- Office area: Ramnagar Fort Road, Ramnagar, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Main phone / WhatsApp: +91 94156 84748
- Additional phone: +91 88879 99972
- Business hours shown on the site: Monday-Saturday, 10:00-19:00 IST
- Property categories: residential, plots, commercial
- Site features: current property listings, direct enquiry, call/WhatsApp contact, site visits, and admin-managed listings
- Fees: commission/service fees are discussed and agreed with the client before a deal proceeds; no fixed percentage is published because the applicable fee can vary by engagement

## Services
- Buying assistance: property shortlisting, enquiries, site visits and negotiation support
- Renting/leasing: residential and commercial property enquiries and tenant coordination
- Selling: property valuation, listing and buyer enquiries
- Documentation support: document collection, title-verification coordination and registry-related paperwork

## Important accuracy notes
- Listing prices, availability and property details can change. Use the current Properties page or contact the business directly for confirmation.
- The site does not claim a specific number of transactions, years of experience, professional certification, RERA registration, awards, or customer testimonials unless those facts are separately published and verified.
- Legal title opinions should be obtained from a qualified independent property lawyer.
